seoTitle: Live Meeting Cost Timer: See What a Meeting Costs
metaDescription: Enter attendees and average salary and start the timer to watch the cost of a meeting grow. Free, private, no data stored.
intro: A timer that converts attendee time into money as the meeting goes on.
why:
Meetings feel free because nobody sees the bill. Showing the running cost in money makes a long agenda and a late start concrete.

The cost uses salary over working hours only, so it understates the real cost because employer charges are not added. The total is announced when you pause, while the running amount updates visually. Nothing is stored or sent.
howTo: Enter attendees, average salary and working hours.
Press Start when the meeting begins.
Press Pause to read the total.

faq.a: It is an estimate: salary time only, without employer charges or lost focus.
Enter hourly pay times working hours as a yearly figure.
